name: NKit
description: Lossless GameCube & Wii preservation, WUA conversion, and Redump restoration.
readme:
### Features
- 1:1 Redump disc verification
- WUA compression
- Lossless GameCube scrubbing
- Loadiine & NKit conversion pipelines

### Usage
```bash
openrom-core convert --plugin nkit --in game.iso --out game.wua
```

NKit restores scrubbed GameCube and Wii images back to their original, byte-perfect Redump state. Every conversion is verified against the community DAT so you always know your dump is clean.

name: Xbox ZAR Suite
description: Extract XISO and compress to .zar for Xenia Edge and Xbox 360 digital libraries.
readme:
### Features
- XISO extraction with full file-tree rebuild
- ZAR compression tuned for Xenia Edge streaming
- GOD to ISO conversion
- Batch mode for entire library folders

### Notes
ZAR archives keep the random-access layout Xenia expects, so titles stream without a full pre-load.

name: Saturn Tools
description: Sega Saturn disc patching, region conversion, and CHD mastering for MiSTer and emulators.
readme:
### Features
- Region-free patching
- BIN/CUE to CHD mastering
- Audio-track preservation
- Saturn Patcher (.ssp) support

### Usage
```bash
openrom-core convert --plugin saturn-tools --in disc.cue --out disc.chd
```

name: Wii U WUA Packer
description: Pack Wii U WUD/WUX disc images into single-file WUA archives with title-key handling.
readme:
### Features
- WUD / WUX to WUA packing
- Title key injection from keys.txt
- Disc verification against the Redump Wii U DAT

### Usage
```bash
openrom-core convert --plugin wiiu-wua-packer --in game.wux --out game.wua
```

name: PSX Disc Forge
description: PlayStation 1 disc mastering: BIN/CUE to CHD, redump verification, and PBG packaging.
readme:
### Features
- Lossless BIN/CUE to CHD conversion
- Multi-track audio cue handling
- Redump PSX DAT verification
- PBG compression for DuckStation

### Usage
```bash
openrom-core convert --plugin psx-disc-forge --in crash.cue --out crash.chd
```

name: PS2 ISO Rebuilder
description: Rebuild, verify, and compress PlayStation 2 DVD images for OPL and internal HDD loading.
readme:
### Features
- ISO rebuild from extracted file trees
- UL.CFG / OPL compatible output
- ZSO compression
- Dual-layer DVD9 split and merge

### Notes
ZSO output is directly readable by OpenPS2Loader over SMB and USB.

name: Dreamcast GDI Optimizer
description: Optimize Dreamcast GDI sets: shrink dummy data, rebuild tracks, and verify against the DAT.
readme:
### Features
- Dummy-data scrubbing without breaking boot sectors
- GDI track rebuild and TOC repair
- DAT verification for every track

### Usage
```bash
openrom-core convert --plugin dreamcast-gdi-optimizer --in sonic.gdi --out sonic.opt.gdi
```

name: CHDMan Wrapper
description: A safe, scriptable front-end for chdman with batch queues and DAT-aware verification.
readme:
### Features
- Batch conversion queues with resume
- Automatic chdman version detection
- Dat-aware verification before and after conversion
- Dry-run mode for large libraries

### Usage
```bash
openrom-core convert --plugin chdman-wrapper --in roms/ --out library/
```

name: ROM Vault Hasher
description: Hash and audit entire ROM collections against No-Intro, Redump, and TOSEC DAT files.
readme:
### Features
- Multi-threaded CRC32 / MD5 / SHA-1 hashing
- No-Intro, Redump and TOSEC DAT support
- Fixdat generation
- Duplicate and corruption reporting

### Usage
```bash
openrom-core audit --plugin rom-vault-hasher --dat redump.dat --dir /roms
```

name: IPS/BPS Auto-Patcher
description: Apply IPS, BPS, and UPS patches automatically, with source-ROM validation and rollback.
readme:
### Features
- IPS, BPS and UPS patch support
- Source CRC validation before patching
- Automatic patch matching by ROM hash
- Non-destructive rollback

### Usage
```bash
openrom-core patch --plugin ips-bps-patcher --rom game.sfc --patch fix.bps
```

name: GameCube Scrubber
description: Safely scrub GameCube ISO padding to shrink libraries while keeping games bootable.
readme:
### Features
- Recoverable padding removal
- Preserves boot and DOL regions
- Reverse scrubbing back to full ISO

### Notes
Pair with NKit for full 1:1 restoration when you need a verified Redump image.

name: SNES Preservation Toolkit
description: Audit, deinterleave, and preserve SNES cartridge dumps including special-chip titles.
readme:
### Features
- Interleaved / deinterleaved dump repair
- Special chip detection (SuperFX, SA-1, DSP)
- Header removal and restoration
- No-Intro SNES DAT verification

### Usage
```bash
openrom-core audit --plugin snes-preservation-toolkit --dir /roms/snes
```
